# Jaipur Eye & Dental Hospital (JEDH)

> Jaipur Eye & Dental Hospital (JEDH) is a comprehensive eye and dental care hospital in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India, operating since 2017. Led by MS and MDS qualified specialists, JEDH has treated 20,000+ patients with a 4.8-star Google rating (20,000+ reviews).

- [Homepage](https://jaipureyedental.com/)
- [Full LLM Context](https://jaipureyedental.com/llms-full.txt)
- [Sitemap](https://jaipureyedental.com/sitemap.xml)

## Leadership

- **Dr. Amit Gupta** — MS Ophthalmology (SMS Medical College, Jaipur), Medical Director & Founder, 7+ years, 10,000+ surgeries
- **Dr. Nehal Gupta** — MDS Prosthodontics & Implantology, Senior Dental Surgeon, 15+ years, 5,000+ patients

## Eye Care Services

- [Cataract Surgery](https://jaipureyedental.com/eye/cataract-surgery.html): Phaco & Femto procedures with premium IOL options. From ₹18,000/eye.
- [LASIK/PRK](https://jaipureyedental.com/eye/lasik-prk.html): Bladeless Femto LASIK, PRK/TransPRK, Contoura Vision. From ₹35,000/eye.
- [Glaucoma Treatment](https://jaipureyedental.com/eye/glaucoma.html): Medical management, laser therapy, surgical options.
- [Pediatric Eye Care](https://jaipureyedental.com/eye/pediatric-myopia.html): Myopia control, amblyopia treatment, pediatric eye exams.

## Dental Care Services

- [Dental Implants](https://jaipureyedental.com/dental/implants.html): Korean and German implant systems with 3D CBCT scanning. From ₹25,000/tooth.
- [Invisalign](https://jaipureyedental.com/dental/invisalign.html): Lite and Comprehensive clear aligner treatments. Certified provider.
- [Cosmetic Dentistry](https://jaipureyedental.com/dental/cosmetic.html): Teeth whitening, porcelain veneers, smile makeovers.
- [Preventive Care](https://jaipureyedental.com/dental/preventive.html): Dental cleanings, fluoride treatments, oral health assessments.

## Pricing

All pricing is transparent: [View full pricing](https://jaipureyedental.com/pricing.html)

### Eye Care Pricing
- Cataract Surgery (Indian IOL): ₹18,000 - ₹25,000/eye
- Cataract Surgery (Imported IOL): ₹30,000 - ₹45,000/eye
- Cataract Surgery (Multifocal IOL): ₹55,000 - ₹75,000/eye
- LASIK Basic: ₹35,000 - ₹45,000/eye
- LASIK Contoura Vision: ₹55,000 - ₹70,000/eye
- PRK/TransPRK: ₹40,000 - ₹55,000/eye

### Dental Care Pricing
- Dental Implant (Korean): ₹25,000 - ₹35,000/tooth
- Dental Implant (German Premium): ₹50,000 - ₹70,000/tooth
- Invisalign Lite: ₹75,000 - ₹1,00,000
- Invisalign Comprehensive: ₹1,50,000 - ₹2,50,000
